theorems.name: Submission.aetp_weightedTangent_of_lusin_compact
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (K : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (x : Amb n ℓ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V.carrier → x ∈ K → ContinuousOn V.mult K → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => V.weight ((V.carrier \ K) ∩ closedBall x (R * r)) / ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n K x P → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n V.carrier V.mult x P
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
